subject: Renewal QBR: consolidated demo, recording & scribe ask

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR: consolidated demo, recording & scribe ask

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. As we discussed, we want to consolidate the two shorter product demos into one cleaner half-day QBR to reduce context switching for your team and ensure the execs see end-to-end value. Proposal (high level):

- Date/time: Tue June 29, 2027 10:00–13:00 PT (we can split a 15-minute break at 11:30)
- Format: 20min exec overview, 40min hands-on roadmap + live demo, 30min breakout on integration + next steps, 20min close/Q&A.
- Recording: we’d like to record the main session and provide a transcript. Please confirm recording consent and whether Healthlytics legal needs a separate form.
- Scribe: can we assign an internal scribe to capture action items and short decisions? We can provide the notes within 24 hours.

Attached is a first-pass run-of-show (HL_QBR_runofshow_v1.pdf). Can you confirm: (1) the proposed slot works for the primary decision-makers, (2) recording permission, and (3) whether Simon or another technical lead will join the integration breakout?

If the 29th is tight, propose two alternates: June 28 (same slot) or July 1 (09:00–12:00 PT).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Mina —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:

1) Slot: June 29 10:00–13:00 PT looks promising but our VP of Product (Asha) is traveling that week. If Asha needs to join live, June 28 would be better.
2) Recording: Legal will need a short consent form signed. I attached our standard recording consent for vendor sessions — please review and confirm.
3) Technical: Simon is available for the integration breakout on either June 28 or June 29.

If it's helpful, we can keep June 29 as the target and set a contingency to move to June 28 if Asha confirms an in-person commitment. I appreciate the run-of-show — I’ll get back with Asha’s availability by EOD tomorrow.

Jamie Park
